Meeting Date:                 4/27/2022
Sponsor(s):                   Scott, Jr. (24)
Type:                         Ordinance
Title:                        Zoning Reclassification Map No. 4-J at 1530 S Kedzie Ave
Committee(s) Assignment:      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
                                      ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance, be amended by changing all ofthe B3-2,
Community Shopping District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 4-J in the
area bound by:

      a line 150 feet south of and parallel to West 15'" Street; South Kedzie Avenue; a line 175
      feet south of and parallel to West 15'" Street; and the alley next west of and parallel to
      South Kedzie Avenue,

to those ofa B2-1, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after Its passage and publication.




                                                          Midhael Scott Jr.
                                                          Alaerman, 24*" Ward




Common Address:
1530 S. Kedzie Avenue
